_doc: graph.publish. out = the default directory of `graph publish` (relative to the repository root; the branch-level stale check looks only there), digest_file = the file in it that remembers what was published, branch = the local branch of --gh-pages. calls = the entry-point pictures: depth levels from each entry point, at most nodes nodes in a picture, at most max pictures (the rest is counted in index.md). modules_rows / edge_rows = the rows of the two tables of index.md. markers = the built-in scan of the rendered text (reason, regular expression, icase): the scan reports the reason and the line, never the text. abs_roots = first path components of an absolute path that must not appear in a published file (the scan reports /<name>/ at a word boundary).

markers.reason: an access key id of a cloud provider
a token of a code host or chat service
